## Patches {.tabset .tabset-pills}

### Autotrophic

#### Absolute

```{r}
ds_patches %>%
  filter(trophic_type == "autotrophic",
         flow == "absolute",
         time_point == 2) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log(patch_size_ml),
             y = bioarea_per_volume,
             group = interaction(patch_size_ml, metaecosystem),
             fill = metaecosystem)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Autotrophic absolute",
    x = label_x_axis_log_patch_size, 
    y = label_y_axis_patch_bioarea
  )
```

#### Relative

```{r}
ds_patches %>%
  filter(trophic_type == "autotrophic",
         flow == "relative",
         time_point == 2) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log(patch_size_ml),
             y = bioarea_per_volume,
             group = interaction(flow_ml, metaecosystem),
             fill = metaecosystem)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Autotrophic relative",
    x = label_x_axis_log_patch_size, 
    y = label_y_axis_patch_bioarea
  )
```


### Heterotrophic

#### Absolute

```{r}
ds_patches %>%
```

#### Relative

```{r}
ds_patches %>%
```
